result.note: Tested the steel safeguard hurdle delaying the India–UK FTA rollout, a concrete trade-policy fact.

questions.prompt: In May 2026, the rollout of the India–UK free trade agreement was delayed. Which issue did India's Commerce Secretary cite as the hurdle?
options: The UK's new steel import safeguards
The UK's new pharmaceutical import curbs
The UK's new textile import rules
The UK's new IT professional visa limits
questions.explain: The UK's stricter steel safeguards were announced in March 2026, take effect from July 1, and had not been factored into negotiations. They sharply reduce tariff-free quotas and impose steep duties beyond them, which could dilute the market access Indian steelmakers expected.
questions.source: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said the UK's stricter steel safeguards, announced in March and set to take effect from July 1, were not factored into negotiations.
